content: LUKAS NUG NAI IMU TIOPILASNU YOM
O danab naḏi Tiopilas, danab kuḏum ag tatam keeke ig oonigp̱a bep̱ig, amunu nai yaap̱ig.
Dig makp̱anu uḵe batakp̱a danab ag keeke amu anidp̱ig ele ag aeg doout yaap̱ig. Ag am Nai Ena mehuqak danab daanna, nai amu aeg doomut.

O danab Naḏi Tiopilas, na ele keeke amunu aeg doome. Aeg doome amunu da ele na nai doome am genab dooḵutnu nahipnu nai amu baula yaaḵulnu ool dayom amunu da keeke amu dig makp̱anu uḵe batakp̱a ele ohnu oḏ mak tutuḵu elelenab hei, aeg doyen, iiḵu elelep̱a yaaṯem.
ENGEL SAKARIAS AMEGP̱A NID MENUḴUNU AUM
Aria haen Herodes oḵai nug Juda dilag king dayeye, mana meṯak danab laa dayom. Nug am ameg laa onig Abaisa ameg, amu oop̱anu, nug onig Sakarias. Nug wau am onig Elisabet. A oh am Aron buḏub.
A oh Kayak noobp̱a tutuḵu oiṯapiḏ. Ḏo nai oh ena dim lamidya, Kayak amegp̱a ele daadṯapiḏ.
Amge a nid iiṯa. Elisabet nug ah maṯoi amunu a hamu oiya, kaino mepiḏ.
Aria haen laa Sakarias laiḵud ele ag uḏat ahilag heḵulagnu haen be, ag henan daanna amu Sakarias nug ele Kayak noobp̱a mana meṯak uḏat nuhig heum.
Nug heehe amu ag nug uḵa, kalu, kahug nuhig muṯuḏig ena ele, amu amotḵunu meeg, nug mana meṯak lag oo gun ele amup̱a noum.
Kalu amotom, haen amup̱a danab ah kuḏum ag dimiṯim qag mena, unuqidnana daap̱ig.
Daaegeg, Sakarias nug uḏat nuhig heehe, Kayaknu engel nug kalu, kahug muṯuḏig ena ele, amu amotaknu qaḏab heqo laih naḏiap̱anu hibaiṯa dayeye, Sakarias nug anṯom.
Sakarias engel anṯa, nug huan oṯaia, oo ele baḏom.
Oo baḏom amge engel nug Sakarias amegp̱a aum. “Na aib baḏame. Unuqiṯak nahip amu Kayak Nug aaḵu doyom. Na waat Elisabet nug geha nid danab menueb amu na nid onig Johanes ataḏe!
Geha na oot ena dayeb, gaman ele ahebeb amu danab ah kuḏum ele nug doumnu gamalag ahaḵu.
Nug Kayak noobp̱a onig ele daaḵu. Nug wain amu kaaka qaknu le laa oh ele ii lama. Nug anig oop̱a dayebeb amu Kayak Ouḏi am nug oop̱a am beḵu.
Dimp̱a nug heeb, Israel danab kuḏum ag Kayaknu kobol dim lamidḵulagnu dab mebep̱eg, ag oolag eḏuḵu.

Nug Kayaknu propet Eliasnu hak g̱agaṯag amubia awa, Naḏi nob awa, anuqa uḵa heeb, danab ag ahilkad nid naunau ele oo mak daaglag. Nug heeb amu nai tap̱e nak danab ag oolag eḏueb, dab mak ena tutuḵu op̱ia awak ele aon daaglag. Nug heeb, danab ah kuḏum Jesus uḏiḵunu babaiṯak daaglag,” awa aum.
Nug anam a, Sakarias nug engel amegp̱a aum. “Da aṯem heina, nai amuam genab daaṯe dooḵul? Da kaino memi amu ah dahil ele kaino meum,” awa aum.
A amu engel nug oḏep̱a awa aum. “Da am Gabriel. Da Kayak noobp̱a daaṯem ele. Kayak nuḵa he, da amenp̱a nai ena imu ap̱i dooḵutnu uḏimi.

Amge na da nai ami amu ootp̱a genab ii doome amunu na oḏen qamuteb, nai ii maṯimna. Iiṯa, na anam daap̱e uḵeb, haen keeke amu oh genab beeb, na eḏun nai madiḵut. Da nai ami amu haen dob, genab meu beḵu,” awa aum.
Aria engel nug nai amu maṯieye, Sakarias nug lag oop̱a dayeye, danab ah ag nug ameg mena daanna, dab mak kuḏum aona, aḵa aḵa ap̱ig. “Lag oo gunp̱a keeke aṯem be, nug haen elab daaṯe?” aon ap̱ig.

Dimp̱a nug dimiṯim doa, nug oḏep̱a ag amelagp̱a nai aḵunu elele iiṯa amunu ag doop̱ig, Kayak Nug mana meṯak lag oop̱a keeke laa ip̱uniṯom. Ag amu doop̱ig amu nug oḏe qamute, nai ii maṯiaya, ep̱egp̱aib he doop̱ig.
Aria anam daye dimp̱a Sakarias nug nuhig uḏat haen, mana meṯak laḵanu, amu male, nug eḏua ap̱agp̱a uḵom.
Uḵa dayeye, dimp̱a nug wau Elisabet oo ele daya, nug kalam tanig ele laḵa loḵuma dayaya nug aum.
“Naḏi Nug dahilnu oo doye, ehaniḏa, uḏa nak dahil danab oh amelagp̱a op̱iom,” awa aum.
ENGEL MARIA AMEGP̱A JESUS MENUḴUNU AUM
Amu Elisabet nug oo ele dayeye, kalam eblaih laip̱u ele oop̱a Kayak Nug engel Gabriel me, Nug Galelia wanp̱a, ab laa onig Nasaret, ap̱a uḵom.
Nug nai awa, ah maḵun laa danab aoḵunu tituanp̱ig ele gumiṯa uḵom. Danab amu onig Josep, nug Dawit buḏub. Ah maḵun amu onig Maria.
Gabriel gumiṯa noa, humiṯa aum. “O ah maḵun, na maḏoḏ ele daye! Kayak Nug na itiṯom. Nahip itiṯak am ah laa oh dilag itiṯak eḏidṯe. Nug na ele daaṯep,” awa aum.
Maria nug nai amu doya, nug oṯaia, dab mak kuḏum awa, nug nuḵa nuhig dab makp̱a aum. “Nai amu aṯemunab?” awa aum.
Anam a amu engel nug amegp̱a aum. “Maria, na aib baḏame. Kayak nahipnu oo ena daaṯe.
Doye, geha na oot ele daanna, nid danab menuna, na Nug onig Jesus ataḏḵut.
Nug am dimp̱a danab Naḏi daaḵu. Ag nuhignu, ‘Kayak aṯannunab beḵa,’ aon aḵulag. Kayak Nug heeb, nug king alag Dawit dayom bia daaḵu.
Nug haen oh Jakop buḏubnu king daaḵu. Nuhig ḏo maḏoḏ amu ii tuqa aoma,” awa aum.
Anam a amu Maria engel amegp̱a aum. “Keeke amuam aṯemutai beḵu? Da danab ii aomi,” awa aum.

Anam a amu engel nug oḏep̱a awa aum. “Geha Kayak Ouḏi nahipp̱a uḏieb, Kayak aṯannunab, nuhig g̱agaṯag na tonidḵu amunu na nid amu, Nug am hak tutuḵuib, Nug ham bup̱uak nakok laa iiṯa, am Nug op̱ia awak ele, amu na Nug menup̱e, ag nuhignu, ‘Kayak Beḵa,’ aona aḵulag.
Doye, na gayap Elisabet nug kaino meum amge nug oo ele. Nug nid danab menuḵu. Anuḵa nug nid menuaknu elele iiṯa amge gemu nug oo ele dayeye, nuhig kalam eblaih laip̱u ele daaṯe.
Anṯe! Kayak Nug keeke oh heḵunu elele,” awa aum.
Anam a amu Maria nug aum. “Da amu Naḏinu uḏat ah. Na ame bia amu Nug dahilp̱a anam heḵu,” awa aum. Awa a amu engel nug eḏua uḵom.
MARIA ELISABET GUMIṮA UḴOM
Engel uḵe haen amup̱a Maria nug aha, paha aben qauko elep̱a, Juda dilag ab laap̱a uḵom.
Uḵa, Sakarias laugp̱a ta, nug Elisabet humiṯom.
Anam he amu Elisabet nug Marianu nai amu doyeye, nid oop̱a niiom amu nug oṯaia, oola te, Kayak Ouḏi Nug Elisabet oop̱a am beum.
Nug oop̱a am be, Elisabet nug Maria amegp̱a ewa aum. “Na am itiṯak ele. Nahip itiṯak amu ah laa oh dilag itiṯak eḏidṯe amu na ootp̱anu nid, Nug ele itiṯak ele.
Naḏi dahil amu, Nug anig da gumiḏa uḏiom amu da amunu ool ena, iṯag qeṯe.
Doye, da daulp̱a nahip humiṯak dooiyi, da oolp̱a nid nug ele gamag ahe, nug oṯaia, oola teum.
Kayak a, na ootp̱a genab doome amunu na Kayaknu itiṯak aome daaṯem. Nug aum amu genab anam beḵu.” Elisabet nug anam aum.
MARIANU AHI
Elisabet nug anam a amu Maria nug aum. “Da ool nug Naḏi binag humaṯe.
Ehaniṯak dahil am Kayak. Da nuhignu gamal ahaṯe.

Aḏinu? Da am nuhig uḏat ah, keeke hamu amge Nug dahilnu oo doyom! Kayak Ebehi Oh Ele Nug keeke naḏinab dahilp̱a heum amunu gemu, buṯi aḏi, dimp̱a ele danab ah buḏub ohp̱a ag aḵulag. ‘Kayak Nug itiṯak oḵai nug meṯom,’ aon aḵulag. Nug onig am inam, Hak Tutuḵuib, Ham bup̱uak Laa Iiṯa, Op̱ia Awak Ele.
Nug danab laala ag nuhignu enanag doon, oolag ele oṯaiṯe amu, Nug amu dilagnu oo gai iiṯa dooṯe. Aun aḏi ag Nug waap̱a daanna oiṯeb ele amu, Nug ahilagnu hanhan anamib dooṯe.
Nug nuhig g̱agaṯagp̱a uḏat haaha, danab ag aḵa binalag humaṯeb ele amu, Nug ag amu ahilag dab mak ele aḵe gop̱ig.
Nug king ebehilag ele tabaṯe noeg, danab onilag iiṯa amu humaṯom.
Nug danab enug aqak doop̱ig ele amu Nug he, oolag am beum. Danab ag enulag ele amu Nug aḏaṯe, ag keeke laa ii aḏap̱ig, hamu gop̱ig.

Nug uḏat danab nuhiḵud Israel ehanaṯom. Nug ig alanḵad Abraham aḏi amu ag buḏulḵad ele, Nug amu dilagnu hanhan oo gai iiṯa dooḵunu ig alanḵad amelagp̱a aum, amubia Nug nai amu daug ii atiṯe. Iiṯa, Nug anam heṯe,” awa aum.
Anam a amu Maria nug Elisabet ele kalam ewam anam dayoya, dimp̱a nug eḏua ap̱agp̱a uḵom.
ELISABET LAYAṮAK JOHANES MENUOM
Maria nug eḏua ap̱agp̱a uḵe, Elisabet nug nuhig nid awak haen be, nug nid danab menuom.
Menue amunu Elisabet mudip̱anu amu nuhiḵudp̱a ele ag Naḏi nuhignu oo gai iiṯa doya ehaniṯom amu doona, ag nug ele gamalag ahom.
Amu deḏ eblaih ewamp̱a ag nid gaḏa otaḏḵulagnu gona, ag nid amu nug mameg onig Sakarias oela qeṯaglagnu ap̱ig
amge nid anig nug aum. “Iiṯa! Ig nug onig Johanes ataḏḵunig,” awa aum.
A amu ag nug amegp̱a ap̱ig. “Na buḏunadp̱a ag onilag anam laa ele iiṯa,” ap̱ig.
Anana, ag ep̱elagp̱a nid amu nug onig aun aḵulagnu nug mameg oḏ medap̱ig.
Ep̱elagp̱a anam heeg amu Sakarias nug ep̱egp̱a yaknu uḏug nug meṯaglagnu heum. He meṯaeg amu nug, “Nid onig amu Johanes,” yom. Anam ye amu ag dab mak kuḏum aop̱ig.
Nug nid onig ye anidna, ag dab mak kuḏum aoegeg amu haen amup̱anab Sakarias nug oḏe op̱ate, lemaḏu ug iiṯa me, nug nai maṯiaya, Kayak binag meum.
Anam he, nug mudip̱anu laiḵud ag oh baḏap̱ig. Aria ag ahan, nai amu tuḏiṯeg, Juda ab aben qauko elep̱a daaṯeb amu ohp̱a uḵom.
Danab oh ag nai amu doona oolagp̱a dab mak kuḏum aona ap̱ig. “Dimp̱a nid amu ena ma amu nug aḏi heḵu,” aon ap̱ig. Aḏinu? Naḏinu g̱agaṯag nug ele dayom amu ag anidp̱ig.
SAKARIASNU AHI
Amu Kayak Ouḏi Nug Johanes mameg Sakarias nug oop̱a am be, Sakarias nug Kayak oḏe mehuqa aum.
“Ig Naḏi, Israel dilag Kayak, Nug binag metu. Aḏinu? Nug Israel danab nuhiḵud ehanaṯa uhuqaṯom. Nug ig eheḏ daamtanu eḏua awiḵak danab g̱agaṯag, nuhig uḏat danab Dawit, nug buḏubp̱a me uḏiom.
Nug anuḵa nuhiḵud propet ag oḏelagp̱a anam heḵunu mehuqa maṯiaya aum amu Nug amu aaḵu heum.
Nug ig kekeḏ ihinḵad ep̱elagp̱anu amu danab laa ag ihinignu oolagp̱a nau, ninig ele dooṯeb amu, ag ep̱elagp̱anu ele eḏua awiḵunu aum.
Nug ig alanḵad dilagnu oo gai iiṯa dooḵunu, Nug ag tituanaṯa, keeke laa heeb beḵunu nai qaḵa aum ele amu, Nug nai aḏit amu daug ii atimanu aum.

Nug ig nuhiḵud begbeg, baḏak iiṯa ele daagnignu, ig Nug noobp̱a danab tutuḵu, op̱ia awak, ham bup̱uak iiṯa, ihinig deḏ oh daagnignu nai genab g̱agaṯag ig alanig Abraham amegp̱a nai qaḵa aum amu Nug keeke amu oh aaḵu ha malom,” awa aum.

Sakarias nug anam anana, nug nai baula tuḏiṯa aum. “O nid dahil, na Naḏinu ib bap̱aidḵutnu, na Kayak, Nug danab nuhiḵud, hip̱unin uhuqak ibp̱a eḏua diiḵunu ip̱uanadḵutnu amu na Naḏi noob aon, anuqna goḵut amunu ag nahipnu, ‘Nug am Kayak aṯannabnu propet,’ aon aḵulag
Kayak ihinig Nug oo gai iiṯa doyak naḏi ele amunu Nug ig ehanigḵu. Geha Nug heeb, hab aṯannu amahlak uḏia, ig amahaligḵu.
Danab ag gatatup̱a mauhḵulagnu miag daaṯeb amu amahlak madaḵu. Nug ig ib oo mak maḏoḏ ele amu tap̱at goḵunignu ulum daaḵu,” awa aum.
Aria dimp̱a nid nug ena meeme, Kayaknu Ouḏi Nug ehaniṯom. Ehaniṯeṯe, nug atu taḏakp̱a dayaya, dimp̱a Israel amelagp̱a Kayak nai dig ma mehuqom.
